market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $2,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: ETH at $2,280-$2,300 on May 8 with 23 days remaining. Hitting $2,000 requires ~12-13% drop. ETH 30-day volatility is high; base rate for >12% pullback in 3 weeks is ~20-30%. Recent trend bearish (ETH failed $2,400, down 2.6% 24h) so slightly elevated, but $2,000 is meaningful support distance.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether broader crypto sell-off accelerates or stabilizes
